Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 10
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner contradicted the stated criterion (earlier birthdate = older) and incorrectly concluded the result by comparing the directors’ ages at the time of their films (37 vs 31) instead of their birthdates. With the correct birthdates sourced (Don McGuire: Feb 28, 1919; Nunzio Malasomma: Feb 4, 1894), Malasomma is older, so One Minute to Twelve has the older director.
